summary:
Implemented the feature by reading and editing files only; nothing was run, installed, or committed, so all new tests are unverified.

New modules: monai/data/csv_saver.py (CSVSaver: save, save_batch, finalize with ordered cache and overwrite=False merge) and monai/data/nifti_saver.py (NiftiSaver: save, save_batch, private static _create_file_basename, dtype None keeps data dtype).

Plot: plot_2d_or_3d_image added to monai/visualize/img2tensorboard.py; existing GIF helpers unchanged.

Adapters: SegmentationSaver, ClassificationSaver (now takes filename, no logging, finalize wrapper accepts optional engine), and TensorBoardImageHandler (new index parameter, delegates to plot function, original ValueError messages kept) are thin wrappers over the savers and plot function.

Other: write_nifti default dtype changed to np.float32; output_path renamed to output_dir in two examples and tests/integration_sliding_window.py; tests/test_handler_classification_saver.py passes filename.

New tests: tests/test_csv_saver.py, tests/test_nifti_saver.py, tests/test_handler_segmentation_saver.py, tests/test_plot_2d_or_3d_image.py. Existing tests/test_handler_tb_image.py left unchanged.

Choices: the segmentation handler passes all meta keys through per-item; CSV finalize guards against makedirs('') for an empty output_dir. No documentation pages changed.
